items.html: How so? Behold, the aforementioned thirty are her three garments, and they are called the body of the Nukva of ZA. And the HaVaYaH that is without vocalization — behold, its last Hey is clothed within the ten Sefirot called the posterior (Achor), and this letter Hey is called the Nefesh of the Nukva. And the letter Vav enters within her middle ten Sefirot and is called the Ruach of the Nukva. And the first Hey enters within her inner ten Sefirot, and this letter is called the Neshama of the Nukva. For just as the NRN are those that are clothed in the brain, the heart, and the liver, so these three letters Hey-Vav-Hey are her NRN, and each one of them is clothed in one garment, as above. And the letter Yod is innermost of them all, and it is called the Neshama of the Neshama (Neshama le-Neshama) of the Nukva.
